name: pwdev-github
description: GitHub Projects from customizable templates, idempotent publishing of pwdev-roadmap/1 roadmaps (issues, sub-issues, milestones, native blocked-by, Project fields), and a skill to create, update and close issues and Project tasks — all through the gh CLI, with a preview before every write.

interface.shortDescription: GitHub Projects, roadmap publishing and issues
interface.longDescription: Create a GitHub Project from a customizable preset or a template Project, publish a roadmap with its dependency chain as issues, sub-issues, milestones and blocked-by links (dry-run first, idempotent and resumable), and create, update, close and move issues and Project tasks one by one or in batches.
defaultPrompt: Create a GitHub Project for this roadmap from the roadmap-produto template.
Close issue #12 as completed and tell me what it unblocks.
